# first-release — command cheatsheet

## Dispatch release branch

```powershell
# UI preferred: Actions → Create Release Branch + PR
# CLI example (input names must match the workflow):
gh workflow run create-release-branch.yml -f kind=release -f version=0.1.1 -f base_branch=develop -f target_branch=main
gh run list --workflow=create-release-branch.yml --limit 3
gh pr list --base main --head release/v0.1.1
```

## Merge release PR (merge commit)

```powershell
# Inspect PR mergeable state, then merge with MERGE (not squash/rebase)
gh pr merge <PR_NUMBER> --merge --subject "merge: release v0.1.1"
# If the API rejects, merge in UI with "Create a merge commit"
```

## Verify npm + GitHub

```powershell
gh release view v0.1.1
npm view @winccoa-tools-pack/<name> version
gh run list --workflow=release.yml --limit 5
gh pr list --base develop --search "upmerge"
```

## Never

- `gh pr merge --squash` for `release/*` → `main`
- Hand-push tags that skip pre-release tarball testing
- Publish from a dirty local tree as a substitute for the release workflow (except documented emergency recovery)
